item.text: {"summary":"The current `Status::SetPayload()` mutates an existing shared `StatusRep` directly, which could explain the copy-assignment and equality failures. The erase failures also involve copy-on-write, but the supplied excerpts do not show `PrepareToModify()` or the `StatusRep` clone and erase behavior, so the cause is not yet established.","hypotheses":["`Status::SetPayload()` bypasses copy-on-write when the status already has a non-inlined representation, allowing payload writes to leak across copies.","`PrepareToModify()` or `StatusRep::ErasePayload()` fails to detach or preserve the original payload when erasing from a shared status."],"queries":["PrepareToModify(","StatusRep::ErasePayload","StatusRep::SetPayload","Status::operator="],"reads":[{"path":"absl/status/status.h","line":0,"symbol":"Status::PrepareToModify"},{"path":"absl/status/status_internal.h","line":0,"symbol":"StatusRep"},{"path":"absl/status/status_test.cc","line":425,"symbol":"CopyAssignmentIsNotRef"},{"path":"absl/status/status_test.cc","line":500,"symbol":"TEST(Status, Equality)"}],"ready":false}
